criterionAssessments.rationale: Prometheus/control-plane onboarding is heavier than Datadog host tiles; pilots are the try-path. Not a lab test.
Observability-monitoring — high-cardinality metrics control plane, ranked with Datadog, not ITSM or PaaS.
Cardinality control, PromQL, and scale workflows are deep; not Datadog’s modular breadth as the product shape.
Prometheus/Kubernetes plus chat/API cover the SRE stack.
Enterprise control-plane governance is adequate; held at 8 versus Datadog’s 9-class admin story.
Built for Prometheus-scale cardinality; this is the buying reason versus SMB observability tiles.
Quote/pilot TCO can beat Datadog module stacking at extreme cardinality — but there is no published floor. Affiliate economics excluded.
Observability assist is supporting — not a reason to skip Datadog, and not an LLM suite.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
